name: APP-FUBINACA
summary: APP-FUBINACA is an indazole-based synthetic cannabinoid that has been sold online as a designer drug. Pharmacological testing showed APP-FUBINACA to have only moderate affinity for the CB1 receptor, with a Ki of 708 nM, while its EC50 was not tested. It contains a phenylalanine amino acid residue in its structure.

pharmacology.text: Pharmacological testing showed APP-FUBINACA to have only moderate affinity for the CB1 receptor, with a Ki of 708 nM, while its EC50 was not tested.

uses.text: APP-FUBINACA is an indazole-based synthetic cannabinoid that has been sold online as a designer drug.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the synthetic cannabinoids, can cause a racing heart, agitation, vomiting, confusion, seizures and psychosis.
sideEffects.zh: 它對人體的影響所知甚少。同類的合成大麻素可能造成心跳急促、躁動、嘔吐、混亂、癲癇發作與精神病。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它对人体的影响所知甚少。同类的合成大麻素可能造成心跳急促、躁动、呕吐、混乱、癫痫发作与精神病。

fact.en: The FUBINACA part of the name is a code: FU for the fluorobenzyl group, B for benzyl, INA for indazole carboxamide. Once you know it, the name tells you most of the structure.
fact.zh: 名稱中的 FUBINACA 是一種代號：FU 代表氟苄基，B 代表苄基，INA 代表吲唑甲醯胺。一旦理解這套規則，名稱本身就說明了大部分結構。
fact.zhHans: 名称中的 FUBINACA 是一种代号：FU 代表氟苄基，B 代表苄基，INA 代表吲唑甲酰胺。一旦理解这套规则，名称本身就说明了大部分结构。
